qa_pairs.question: How can a user request a full H100 GPU for a job on the Nibi cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: To request one H100-80gb GPU, use `--gpus=h100:1` or `--gpus=h100_80gb:1`. For multiple H100-80gb GPUs per node, use `--gpus-per-node=h100:2`, `--gpus-per-node=h100:3`, or `--gpus-per-node=h100:4`. To request multiple full H100 GPUs spread anywhere, use `--gpus=h100:n`, replacing 'n' with the desired number of GPUs.

qa_pairs.question: What is Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) technology on Nibi, and what are the available H100 MIG instance sizes and their specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) technology is configured on approximately half of Nibi's GPU nodes. The three available H100 MIG instance sizes are H100-1g.10gb (1/8th of the computing power with 10GB GPU memory), H100-2g.20gb (2/8th of the computing power with 20GB GPU memory), and H100-3g.40gb (3/8th of the computing power with 40GB GPU memory).
